_comment: The sample games an install ships so a fresh AutoBleem is not an empty shelf: homebrew whose licence lets us
redistribute it (every entry names it), one per system at least. tools/build_samples.py downloads each file
from its upstream release (sha256-checked), lays it out as it lands on the data partition and packs
samples-<date>.tar.gz for the download repository (samples/); payload_linux/install.sh fetches that.
same name in the thumbnails tree. Covers: tools/samples/make_covers.py -> covers/ (checked in).
'shot' is the screenshot make_covers.py draws from (a file under tools/samples/shots/, from the game's own

No PS1 game today: Tetrade (MIT, PSn00bSDK) was the one until 2026-09-20 - it does not run on pcsx-ab (see CLAUDE.md), and no other PS1 homebrew with a redistributable licence and a disc image turned up. The PSX layout code in build_samples.py stays for when one does.
